english.title: Importer fail to maintain record of UK reg number of pyrotechnic (not F1/F2/F3 firework) placed on market
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the importer of a pyrotechnic article other than a category F1, F2 or F3 firework, namely **(..SPECIFY PYROTECHNIC ARTICLE..), and placed it on the market before 17th October 2016 and failed

(A)_[to maintain a record of the UK registration number of the pyrotechnic article for a period of at least 10 years beginning on the day on which it was placed on the market, that date being **(..SPECIFY DATE ARTICLE PLACED ON THE MARKET..)]_
(B)_[upon request, to make a record of the UK registration number of the pyrotechnic article available to an enforcing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY ENFORCING AUTHORITY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20(1), 62(2)(g) and 63(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being an importer
placed a pyrotechnic article on the market pre 17/10/16
failed to maintain record of UK registration number of article for 10 years OR
failed, upon request, to make the record available to enforcing authority

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) applies (i.e. a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is summary only - see offence document H12307 (CJS code PA15070)
(ii) If it is a manufacturer who has placed the pyrotechnic article on the market offence document H12281 (CJS code PA15044) should be used

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
